name: apple_status
title: Apple Bridge status
description: Shows your access (level and scopes), which Apple sources are ready, and the Mac's time zone and time. Not needed before other calls; use it when a source is empty or refused. Reads nothing private.

name: apple_describe
title: Find operations
description: Look up what you can do. query: the best operations for a task in plain words, such as screen time yesterday or get voicemail, best first. operation: its exact arguments, an example call, the access it needs and what it returns. domain: that domain's operations. No arguments: every operation, one line each.

domain.description: Domain name, such as reminders or messages.

name: apple_search
title: Search Apple data
description: Search the owner's data for text in one call: contacts, messages, notes, mail, reminders, calendar, files, Safari, voicemail and other synced records. Returns matches grouped by source with ids, which sources have more, and which were not searched. Photos: use photos_find.

sources.description: Only these sources, such as notes, mail, calendar or messages, or a collection such as notes.note. Default all you can read.

after.description: The after value a source returned in more, to get its next page. Use with sources set to that one source.

name: apple_read
title: Read Apple data
description: Run any read operation; reads never change anything. Common reads need no lookup, arguments optional: reminders.lists {}; reminders.items {"list":"Groceries"} or {"smart":"today"}; notes.list {}; one record by id: records.get {"id":"nte_…"}. For others, apple_describe gives the arguments. Paging: pass next back as after, or next_cursor as cursor for Photos. reads runs up to 10 reads in one call.

operation.description: Read operation name, such as reminders.items.

arguments.description: The operation's arguments, as apple_describe lists them.

fields.description: Keep only these data fields in each record, such as title and due.

reads.description: Instead of operation: up to 10 reads to run together. Each result or error comes back in results, in order.

request_id.description: Only for reads the owner must approve, such as location.current: repeat the call with the same request_id after approval.

verbose.description: Return the full result with coverage and sync details. Default false.

name: apple_change
title: Change Apple data
description: Run any operation that changes data, such as calendar.update_event or reminders.complete; get its arguments from apple_describe. Waits up to 15 seconds and returns status: done (with ids and the changed record), partial (some parts happened: see parts), pending, awaiting_approval, failed or indeterminate. Updates and deletes need expected_version, the record's version from your read.

arguments.description: The operation's arguments, including expected_version where needed.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change, letters, digits and ._:- up to 120 characters. Reuse it to retry safely. Default: a new one.

verbose.description: Include the full history and the Mac's raw result. Default false.

name: apple_command_status
title: Check a change
description: Check a change that came back pending or indeterminate, including Photos changes, by its request_id. Returns the same result as apple_change.

request_id.description: The request_id from apple_change or another changing tool.

verbose.description: Include the full history and the Mac's raw result. Default false.

name: apple_guide
title: Read a guide
description: Read a short how-to: core (start here), setup, messages, reminders-calendar, photos or files. No name lists them.

name: messages_read
title: Read messages
description: Read Messages. No arguments: recent chats with unread counts (unread: only unread chats). with: a person's chat by phone number, email or name, plus their group chats as other_chats. chat_id: that chat. In a chat, unread starts at the first unread message and before pages back. text: messages containing these words in any chat (unread: only unread ones). after pages chat lists and text results.

with.description: Phone number, email or contact name of the other person.

chat_id.description: A cht_ chat ID from an earlier result.

text.description: Words to find in messages, across all chats. Not with with or chat_id.

unread.description: Only unread chats or messages; in a chat, start at the first unread message.

before.description: In a chat: the before value from the previous result, for older messages.

after.description: For chat lists and text results: the after value from the previous result, for the next page.

name: messages_send
title: Send a message
description: Send an iMessage, SMS or RCS. to: phone number, email or contact name, used only if it matches one person and one chat (otherwise you get the candidates); or chat_id from messages_read, also for group chats. The text is sent exactly as given. done means the Messages app on the Mac shows it sent, not that it was delivered.

to.description: Phone number in international form, email, or a contact's name.

chat_id.description: An existing chat's cht_ ID. Use instead of to.

text.description: Message text, sent exactly as given. Optional with photos.

photos.description: asset_ids from photos_find; attaches the original files.

service.description: Only for a number or email without an existing chat. Default iMessage.

request_id.description: Your ID for this send; repeating it never sends twice.

name: reminders_add
title: Add a reminder
description: Add a reminder. list: a list name or lst_ ID; default the first list in Reminders. Returns the new reminder's id. To complete, change or delete one, use apple_change with reminders.complete, reminders.update or reminders.delete and reminder set to its title.

list.description: List name, such as Groceries, or a lst_ ID.

due.description: Due time as RFC 3339, such as 2026-11-12T09:00:00-06:00, or a date YYYY-MM-DD.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change; repeating it never adds twice.

name: calendar_events
title: List calendar events
description: List calendar events with start and end in UTC and in the Mac's time zone (start_local, end_local). Default today in the Mac's time zone. date for one day, or start and end for a range, not both; text to filter by title, notes or location; calendar by name or cal_ ID.

end.description: Range end, exclusive, RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD.

calendar.description: Only this calendar: its name, such as Work, or cal_ ID.

name: calendar_add
title: Add a calendar event
description: Add a calendar event. calendar: a calendar name, such as Work, or cal_ ID; default the first calendar you can add to. Times without an offset are in the Mac's time zone; a start date YYYY-MM-DD makes an all-day event. Returns the new event's id.

start.description: Start, such as 2026-11-12T15:00 or 2026-11-12T15:00:00-06:00, or a date YYYY-MM-DD for all day.

end.description: End, after start. Default one hour after start, or the same day for all day.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change; repeating it never adds twice.

name: contacts_find
title: Find a contact
description: Find people by name (words in any order, accents and case ignored), part of a name, phone number or email. Returns up to 25 contacts with their phones, emails and con_ IDs.

query.description: A name such as Ana Novak, part of a name, a phone number or an email.

name: notes_create
title: Create a note
description: Create a plain-text note, kept exactly as given. folder: a folder name or fld_ ID; default the Notes folder. Returns the new note's id. To read notes, use apple_search or apple_read with notes.list.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change; repeating it never creates twice.

name: screen_time
title: Screen Time
description: Screen Time per device (Mac, iPhone, iPad): total and top apps, estimated from app focus. Default yesterday in the Mac's time zone; date for one day, or start and end.

date.description: One day as YYYY-MM-DD. Default yesterday.

start.description: First day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Last day of a range, inclusive.

device.description: Only this device, by part of its name, such as iPhone.

name: photos_find
title: Find photos
description: Find photos by date, type, album, favorite or place: a numbered grid only for you to scan (never show it), with each number's asset_id. One match returns the photo itself.

start.description: Taken on or after, RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the last result, same filters.

name: photos_show
title: Show a photo
description: The photo itself, to show the person: full frame and resolution, nothing drawn on it.

save.description: Also save the original file on the Mac; returns its path as file.
